paper_title: Earth as a transducer for axion dark-matter detection
notes: Paper presents a new experimental search for ultralight axion dark matter using Earth's geomagnetic field as a transducer. The axion-photon coupling g_agamma is constrained in the mass range 2×10^-18 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 7×10^-17 eV using SuperMAG magnetometer network data. The strongest constraints reach g_agamma ≲ 6.5×10^-11 GeV^-1 for 3×10^-17 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 4×10^-17 eV, comparable to CAST helioscope bounds. The analysis assumes the axion comprises all dark matter with local density ρ_dm = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. No robust signal candidates were identified; 27 naive candidates were rejected through robustness checks. The limit is presented as a smoothed exclusion band in Fig. 1.
